fusions.name: Pressure Point
fusions.desc: A two-finger strike to a nerve that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, and leaves it [Hindered] and 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thousandth Kata
fusions.desc: Sweeps an open palm through a cone 2.5 tiles deep, dealing 7 damage to everything in it. Holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Daily Scales
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Economy of Motion
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner.
